<security_assessment>

<details>
The provided `.SRCINFO` file is a metadata file used by Arch Linux's AUR to describe the package build configuration. It references a prebuilt Python wheel (`zuban-0.9.3-py3-none-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl`) downloaded from the official and trusted source `https://files.pythonhosted.org`, which is the standard PyPI CDN endpoint. The file includes a b2sum hash for integrity verification, indicating a proper checksum is in place — there is no use of 'SKIP' here.

There are no executable commands, scripts, or build instructions in this file — it is purely declarative metadata. The package depends only on standard system libraries (glibc, libgcc), provides and conflicts with `zuban`, and marks the wheel file as `noextract`, which is typical for binary packages where extraction is handled manually in the PKGBUILD. No network operations, file manipulations, or system modifications are described in this file.

Since `.SRCINFO` is not executed and only serves to mirror PKGBUILD contents for tooling, and since all referenced sources and hashes align with expected packaging practices, there is no evidence of malicious behavior.
</details>
